svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 11 (CUMULATIVE R491) · HOST REACHABILITY, MCP ATTESTATION & SKILL PINNING
agent-leakcheck (--fix Grade A) + mcp-attest (24-Rule Live RBAC) + skillset + otpkit (★59)
1. globalmpc/agent-leakcheck (★14 · Zero-Dep Node 20+ · MIT)
• Host Reachability Scanner & "--fix" Auto-Remediator (Grade A-F)
Audits Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor & Gemini CLI with 0 network egress
Fixes env-deny (.env access), risky-mode (Bash(*)), mcp-plaintext & cc-version < 2.1.317
2. itsmeyaw/skillset (★12 · Wraps Vercel skills.sh · MIT)
• Curates agent skills into ./skillset.json pinned to exact Git commit SHAs
• Writes native skills-lock.json & installs only necessary project skills
• Prevents upstream rug-pulls and eliminates unused skill token bloat
• Safe by default: never deletes existing project skills outside the Skillset
3. Balanov/mcp-attest (★9 · 24-Rule Live Conformance · MIT)
• "Prove That Your MCP Server Denies What It Must Deny"
Connects as each policy identity (e.g., alice) and sends real tool calls (refund_order)
24 rules: RBAC denials, OAuth checks, hidden prompt injection & leaked AWS keys
4. SecFathy/otpkit (★59 · 4 forks · Zero-Key OTP MCP · MIT)
• Creates disposable emails (grabmail, catchmail, guerrillamail) & public SMS numbers
• Polls every 5s & auto-extracts 4-8 digit OTP codes + ranked verification links
• Zero API keys required; isolates E2E auth QA from corporate email accounts
• Ranks URLs containing verify, confirm, activate, token, reset & login first
